preconditions.description: n is divisible by 5 and within the specified range; b is within the specified range; q is within the specified range.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= upToi <= b and 0 <= quantityi <= n for upToi, quantityi in hints)
preconditions.description: Each hint's upToi is within the specified range; each hint's quantityi is within the specified range.

postconditions.expression: if return_value == 'fair': any(all((x % 5 == r for x in set if x <= upToi) == quantityi for r in range(5)) for set in possible_sets)
postconditions.description: If the output is 'fair', there exists at least one set that satisfies all conditions and matches all hints.

postconditions.expression: if return_value == 'unfair': all(not any((x % 5 == r for x in set if x <= upToi) == quantityi for r in range(5)) for set in possible_sets)
postconditions.description: If the output is 'unfair', no set satisfies all conditions and matches all hints.
